semiconductor_relevance: High — Mycropore Corporation provides critical micro-contamination control products essential for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Mycropore Corporation specializes in micro-contamination control solutions for the semiconductor and microelectronics industries. Their products, including advanced CMP filters and gas filters, are designed to meet the stringent contamination control requirements of leading semiconductor fabs and equipment makers.

regional_presence.Singapore: Originally established in Singapore, Mycropore has a significant presence with an ISO 9000 certified clean room facility.
regional_presence.Taiwan: Relocated to Taiwan, where they continue to operate their R&D center and serve major semiconductor customers.
